description: This script automates the process of generating documentation for plugins by analyzing changed files, validating JSON outputs, invoking doc generation from headers and JSON outputs, and postprocessing markdown files. It is part of an automated documentation workflow for a modular plugin-based system.

methods.name: get_plugin_from_path(file_path)
methods.description: Extracts plugin name from a given file path based on its directory structure.

methods.name: validate_json_changes(changed_files)
methods.description: Checks that for each JSON change in 'apis/', a corresponding output JSON exists in 'tools/md_generator/json/'.

methods.name: get_plugins_to_process(changed_files)
methods.description: Identifies plugins that need documentation regeneration based on changed files.

methods.name: generate_docs_for_plugin(plugin_name, file_types, logfile=None)
methods.description: Handles documentation generation by calling header or JSON-based tools for a specific plugin.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Performs cleanup and modifications on generated markdown files.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Runs a script to update the documentation sidebar after generation.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main orchestrator that parses arguments, validates changes, determines plugins to process, calls generation functions, and finalizes the process.
